# drawbridge — social media domains
#
# Curated and pinned by SHA-256 in dist/policy.json, unlike the large upstream
# lists which rotate daily. Entries cover the parent domain only; matching is
# suffix-based, so `facebook.com` also blocks `m.facebook.com`.
#
# YouTube is blocked outright here. The safe-search rewriting in DnsFilter still
# maps youtube.com to restrictmoderate.youtube.com, but blocking is checked first,
# so the redirect only takes effect if YouTube is removed from this list.

# YouTube — all of it, including Kids, TV, Music, Studio and embeds.
# Matching is suffix-based, so youtube.com already covers m., music., tv.,
# kids. and studio.youtube.com; only separate registrable domains and the
# specific googleapis hosts need listing.
youtube.com
youtu.be
youtubekids.com
youtube-nocookie.com
ytimg.com
googlevideo.com
yt3.ggpht.com
youtubei.googleapis.com
youtube.googleapis.com
